body.data:
SELECT
    M.MERCHANT_ID,
    M.REQUEST_ID,
    M.CIF,
    M.NATIONAL_ID,
    M.BANK_ACCOUNT,
    M.OWNER_NAME_AR,
    M.COMPANY_NAME,
    M.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
    M.MERCHANT_NAME_AR,
    M.CONTACT_NAME_AR,
    M.ADDRESS_EN,
    M.ADDRESS_AR,
    M.CITY,
    M.REGION,
    M.BRANCH_CODE,
    M.BRANCH_NAME,
    M.TEAM_LEADER,
    M.RM_NAME,
    M.RM_ORACLE_CODE,
    M.MCC,
    M.CATEGORY_EN,
    M.CATEGORY_AR,
    M.PACKAGE_CODE,
    M.CONTRACT_MDR,
    M.STANDARD_MDR,
    M.MDR_APPROVAL_STATUS,
    M.MDR_SWITCH,
    M.QR_MDR,
    M.WALLET_QR_NUMBER,
    M.CUSTOMER_TYPE,
    M.EXPECTED_MONTHLY_TPV,
    M.OWNS_OTHER_POS,
    M.OTHER_POS_COMMISSION,
    M.CREATED_AT,
    M.UPDATED_AT,
    M.CREATED_BY,
    M.UPDATED_BY
FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MERCHANT M
WHERE M.MERCHANT_ID = HEXTORAW('{{ appsmith.URL.queryParams.MERCHANT_ID || "59F2A096E5047D26E063C642320AB95B" }}')
  AND M.IS_DELETED = 0
